messages:
Maya (Manager): quick check-in 10am: Eli accepted the org invite but says he can't push to any private repos. Anyone around to help?
Eli (New Hire): hey all 10:02am - I can view some public repos but trying to clone private repo returns 404 over HTTPS and permission denied for SSH. I added my SSH key to GitHub.
Priya (IT): common sad face. First: can you paste the exact git clone error? also confirm which GitHub username you used for the invite.
Eli (New Hire): clone error: "remote: Repository not found." and over SSH: "Permission denied (publickey)." My GH username is elijah-dev and I accepted invite to elijah.work@gmail.com (tied to that account).
Onboarding Bot: Invitation accepted by elijah-dev at 2024-11-20 09:44 UTC. Added to team: rw-models (SSO required).
Priya (IT): ahhh — looks like the invite went to your personal GH account. Did you also have alex@redwood.com on file? We typically send invites to your company email.
Eli (New Hire): I used my personal account to accept because I saw the email there first. I do have a separate work account (eli@redwood.com) but didn't realize.
Nate (DevOps): That explains the SSH problem: your SSH key is on personal account, and the personal account isn't on the rw-models team (or SSO authorized). Two options: 1) add your work email as a secondary email on personal account and authorize SSO (not recommended), 2) ask IT to resend invite to eli@redwood.com and then re-add your SSH key to the work account, or 3) we can transfer team membership to the personal account temporarily if you prefer.
Priya (IT): we prefer option 2 for org security. Eli, please confirm you can access eli@redwood.com. I'll revoke the old invite and send a new one. Also: do you have 2FA enabled on the work account? Our org requires 2FA.
Eli (New Hire): work email active. 2FA is not set on that account yet. I can enable it now.
Priya (IT): cool - enable 2FA (TOTP) on the work account; add the SSH key there after you accept the invite. I'll send the invite to eli@redwood.com now.
Onboarding Bot: Admin action: Invitation sent to eli@redwood.com at 2024-11-20 09:50 UTC. Previous invite to elijah-dev revoked.
Eli (New Hire): got the invite and accepted. Prompted to authorize SSO. Did that.
Nate (DevOps): once you're SSO-authorized, double-check by visiting https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/people and ensure your teams column lists rw-models. Then try `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/model-evals.git`.
Eli (New Hire): I see rw-models in the org people page now. Cloning works (:party_parrot:). SSH key had to be re-added to the work account.
Maya (Manager): woo! two small onboarding lessons for the doc? 1) remind folks to accept invites on their work account only, 2) enable 2FA before accepting if possible.
Priya (IT): will update the new-hires checklist to explicitly say: "Use your company GitHub account (eli@redwood.com) for invites; enable 2FA; add SSH keys to the work account; if you accidentally accepted with a different account, ping IT to revoke and resend." I'll also add a short note about SSO auth flow.
Eli (New Hire): thanks everyone, sorry for the confusion and thanks for the speedy help.
Maya (Manager): welcome again :)
